job satisfaction depends on the combination of factors such as: teamwork, supervisor support, personal environment fit and job security.
(1) job satisfaction is a result of a combination of factors, (2) the factors that have the strongest impact on job satisfaction are teamwork and supervisor support.

the paths to explain employee satisfaction are: teamwork and supervisor support; personal environment fit, supervisor support and job security with absence of work-family balance; work-family balance, job security, and supervisor support.

the development of a theory of job satisfaction and provides new knowledge for practitioners and academics in the field of human resources management.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the combination of factors such as teamwork and supervisor support is a sufficient condition for high job satisfaction.

the most important paths for explaining the job satisfaction of Polish employees are: teamwork and supervisor support and work family balance, personal environment fit and supervisor support with job security.
employees’ job satisfaction can be explained by a number of different paths.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is no single path to explain job satisfaction, but there are several paths that can be taken.
job satisfaction is not only the result of a single factor, but the outcome of a set of factors.
the most important factors which explain job satisfaction are teamwork, personal environment, job security and supervisors support.
The main takeaway from our work is that
job satisfaction can be achieved by creating a work environment in which employees have good relations with their supervisor and feel secure in the workplace.

job satisfaction is a complex phenomenon, and the results of this study indicate that the factors that influence job satisfaction should not be studied individually, but in combination with each other.
job satisfaction is a very complex phenomenon and there is no universal path that can explain job satisfaction.
